title: Discharge from Memory Care: Executive Director Authority and the Discharge Period
content:
A Memory Care Residency Agreement residency may end without a notice of termination from the family - by death, or by a discharge. A discharge ends the residency either because the resident's needs exceed what Larkspur memory care provides or for nonpayment; from a temporary absence, a residency may also end by death or by a discharge because the resident cannot return.

## Authority and timing

1. **Who issues a nonpayment discharge notice.** A discharge notice for nonpayment may be issued by the executive director only after a charge has remained past due for the tier's past-due period before a discharge notice. The Resident and Family Services desk never issues or withdraws a discharge notice.
2. **Discharge period.** The residency may be ended for discharge only once the discharge notice period has passed since the written discharge notice. The discharge period is counted in calendar days from the notice date on the residency, and the residency may be ended on the notice date plus 30 calendar days or later. The discharge notice period is 30 calendar days on every tier.
3. **What the record shows.** A residency ended without notice is recorded with the vacate date (the date the belongings were removed), the date of the death notification or of the discharge notice, and the ending reason - death, discharge because needs exceed what memory care provides, or discharge for nonpayment.

## Discharge period boundary (hypothetical dates)

Written discharge notice dated 15 January.

| Proposed ending date | Calendar days from the notice date | Residency may be ended for discharge |
|---|---|---|
| 13 February | 29 | No |
| 14 February | 30 | Yes |
| 20 February | 36 | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- The count starts from the notice date recorded on the residency, which is day 0; the ending date may be that date plus 30 days or any later date.
- A nonpayment discharge notice is issued by the executive director; the Resident and Family Services desk neither issues nor withdraws a discharge notice.
